auth_method.description: Auth method the plugin uses against Vault.

deny.description: Deny-list of (host, user) pairs; the provider defaults to allow-all (dev/test). Each entry is `{host?, user?}`; an empty field means wildcard on that dimension (symmetric to soul-ssh-static).

role.description: Name of the Vault SSH role under which the key is signed.

token.description: Vault token for auth_method=token. Alternative — env VAULT_TOKEN inside SOUL_SSH_VAULT_PARAMS. SENSITIVE.

valid_principals.description: Allowlist of principals (Linux users) that the plugin allows to be placed into the signed cert. Empty list = accept any `req.user` (if the Vault role allows it). Hard restriction for production.

vault_addr.description: Base URL of the Vault API (https://vault.example.com:8200).

vault_mount.description: Vault SSH CA mount path (no leading/trailing slash).
